name: Aqidah: Schools of Creed
short_description: Narrows the Islamic religious_school slot to schools of creed (aqidah: Ashari/Maturidi/Athari/Mutazili/Wahhabi for Sunnis, new Usuli/Akhbari for Twelver Shia). Madhhab moves into a decoupled, directly-selectable sharia_law. Standalone; compatible with Improved Culture Dynamics. Pairs with (but does not require) 'Sufi Tariqa Orders'.
